template.name: springboot_alert_email
template.title: [__STREAM__] {alert_name}
template.body:
{alert_name}

{alert_count} row(s) matched {alert_operator} {alert_threshold} over the last {alert_period} minutes, in {stream_type} stream {stream_name} ({org_name}).

Window: {alert_start_time} → {alert_end_time}

Open in OpenObserve

{rows}

alerts.name: error_log_spike
alerts.description: At least 10 ERROR logs in the last hour.

query_condition.sql: SELECT to_char(to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') as at, severity, body, code_namespace, trace_id FROM "__STREAM__" WHERE severity = 'ERROR'

alerts.name: unhandled_exception_logged
alerts.description: Fires as soon as a log body contains 'Unhandled exception'.

alerts.name: slow_http_request
alerts.description: Any server span slower than 1s in the last 5 minutes. Span durations are microseconds.

query_condition.sql: SELECT to_char(to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') as at, operation_name, duration / 1000.0 as duration_ms, trace_id FROM "__STREAM__" WHERE span_kind = 2 AND duration > 1000000

alerts.name: no_traces_received
alerts.description: No server span in the last 10 minutes - the app is down or OTLP export broke. The query spans 6 hours so it still returns a row while the app is silent; the 10-minute window is the conditional sum.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, sum(CASE WHEN _timestamp > (extract(epoch from now()) * 1000000 - 600000000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as recent FROM "__STREAM__" WHERE span_kind = 2 GROUP BY service_name

alerts.row_template: {service_name}: {recent} server spans in the last 10 minutes
